about: One short row per Super Soul the owner has; src/domain/xv2/soul-sheet.ts expands each into a full catalog record. effects are [condition, lines] pairs copied from the wiki's Super Soul list: each line is the effect, then its size and duration where the list gives them. n is the soul's number in that list and stars its level there. text is the in-game text where an owner screenshot showed it. needs names the catalog skill or Awoken a condition depends on. grades are MODEL judgments worked out from the lines by the rules in docs/ingest/catalog/GRADING.md; each reason quotes the line it rests on. The two hand-written souls in catalog.json are not repeated here.
